title: Samsung Display to become ams OSRAM's largest shareholder in microLED push
html: Samsung Display has signed an agreement to acquire a 9.1% equity interest in Ams Osram for approximately EUR210 million (US$230.14 million), a deal that is expected to make it the largest shareholder in the light-emission and optical-sensing semiconductor...
